title: Enhanced Temperature Sensitivity in Ensemble NV Centers through Improved Optically Detected Magnetic Resonance Spectral Modeling
summary: Nitrogen-vacancy (NV) center ensembles provide a powerful platform for high-precision temperature sensing, with ongoing efforts to further enhance their measurement performance. In ensemble NV optically detected magnetic resonance (ODMR) spectra, commonly used Lorentzian and Voigt fitting models fail to accurately describe the spectral shape near the resonance frequency, leading to degraded precision in resonance-frequency determination and, consequently, temperature estimation.
